description:
DNG Declan Woulfe are delighted to present to the market this impressive and spacious detached residence, set on a substantial landscaped site of approximately 0.21 Ha (0.51 Acre), enjoying stunning views of the West Limerick countryside.

Offering a combination of space, privacy and versatile accommodation, this property is ideally suited to modern family living. The house benefits from bright and generously proportioned living and reception areas, with excellent additional space provided by a spacious converted attic room and second large family room upstairs.

The property enjoys a tranquil and private setting, with mature hedging and beautifully maintained lawned gardens to both the front and rear. The outdoor space is further enhanced by a garden room/pergola and a dedicated outdoor entertainment area with built-in seating and a built-in BBQ, providing the perfect setting for family gatherings and entertaining during the summer months.

Located within close proximity to the villages of Kilmeedy and Castlemahon, the property benefits from school transport available at the doorstep. The county town of Newcastle West is approximately 9km away, offering a wide range of amenities, schools, shops, restaurants and recreational facilities, while Limerick City is also within easy commuting distance.

The property is approached via entrance gates and a front boundary wall, with ample parking and extensive outdoor space. A large detached garage measuring approximately 7m x 6.1m further complements the property and includes a 6 inch poured concrete floor, electric roller door, electricity and WC.

Accommodation comprises:

Entrance Hall, Kitchen/Dining Room, Living Room, Utility Room, laundry room,4 Bedrooms (1 Ensuite), Family Bathroom, A Spacious Attic Room with WC and a separate family room upstairs.

Viewing of this impressive family home is highly recommended and is strictly by appointment.
